Layers that stay in lockstep

The companion keeps conversational intuition and structured analytics perfectly aligned.

Behind every response, FastAPI coordinates secure access to datasets, DuckDB powers agile modelling, and async workers enrich results. The LLM interprets intent, drafts strategy, and narrates outcomes—always with traceable artefacts you can revisit.

01 Conversation canvas

Multi-turn threads capture prompts, decisions, and supporting files. Filters make it effortless to revisit a critical hypothesis, a generated transformation plan, or a recommended experiment.

  • • Memory that follows each storyline
  • • AI-crafted recaps for quick catch-up
  • • Instant branching for “what-if” explorations
02 Model insight studio

Lightweight pipelines translate conversational intent into metrics, anomaly scans, and visuals across files, APIs, or web sources. The companion explains each step so everyone understands the why—not just the what.

  • • Inline commentary on every transformation
  • • Side-by-side metric and narrative comparisons
  • • Visual templates ready for export
03 Companion control tower

Async workers run heavy lifting in the background: schedule refreshes, fetch external signals, and push summaries downstream. Dashboards keep you aware of health, latency, and cost impact.

  • • Queue visibility and retry orchestration
  • • Cost and usage trackers per user
  • • Webhook-ready briefings for instant sharing

Designed for real work

Every layer communicates, so momentum never breaks.

When you ask the companion for help, it understands your objective, checks data availability, spins analyses with DuckDB, and loops in worker automations. You stay focused on the narrative—even as complexity grows.

  • Consistency

    Shared prompt libraries and response patterns keep analyses aligned, whether you are starting fresh or building on a teammate’s work.

  • Trust

    Every suggestion links back to the source—spreadsheet, API response, or worker snapshot. Audit trails remain a click away.

  • Moments of delight

    Animated highlights and story cues draw attention to what matters, helping stakeholders grasp the narrative instantly.
